cards.title: Baseline & judge
items: Every eval is candidate version vs a frozen baseline version
Fixed judge (claude-haiku + judge-v1) so the judge can't drift
Per-dimension scores drive the 'vs baseline' regression deltas
Suites < minCases are flagged low-confidence (widen threshold)

cards.title: Drift model
items: Published/archived agents never auto-transition — drift surfaces as a badge
needsReEval is cleared only on a passing run

cards.title: Gate (hard block)
items: publishAgent blocks until a passing eval newer than the last model/prompt/knowledge change
computeVerdict: cases<min → low_confidence; quality<threshold or costΔ>budget → fail
Shared by page + dialog so UI guidance can't diverge from the store block

cards.title: Mock seams vs real contract
items: simulateEvalRun scores are Math.random; assertions never execute
Real job: POST /api/v1/agents/:id/evals → 202 {job_id}; worker runs each case through runtime.invoke(run_source=eval, allow_cache=False)
UI polls GET /api/v1/jobs/:id; publish gate is POST /api/v1/versions/:vid/publish → 409 until a PASS newer than the last trigger
